name: Woodbury County, IA
findings: Woodbury County has 407 nonprofit organizations. 91 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 74 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Woodbury County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 38 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 6 arts and cultural organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
